mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId}
SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,batch_id,service_id,reference_price_snapshot,negotiated_price,display_order,active,created_at,updated_at,row_version FROM public.health_examination_batch_services WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY display_order,id
SELECT id,batch_id,examination_date FROM public.health_examination_batch_days WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY examination_date,id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_batches SET batch_code=#{batchCode},name=#{name},examination_site_type=#{examinationSiteType},examination_site_name=#{examinationSiteName},examination_site_address=#{examinationSiteAddress},status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.health_examination_batch_days(id,batch_id,examination_date) VALUES (#{item.id},#{item.batchId},#{item.examinationDate}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_batch_services SET display_order=display_order+(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order),0)+#{itemCount} FROM public.health_examination_batch_services WHERE batch_id=#{id}) WHERE batch_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.health_examination_batch_services(id,batch_id,service_id,reference_price_snapshot,negotiated_price,display_order,active,row_version) VALUES (#{item.id},#{item.batchId},#{item.serviceId},#{item.referencePriceSnapshot},#{item.negotiatedPrice},#{item.displayOrder},#{item.active},#{item.rowVersion}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET negotiated_price=EXCLUDED.negotiated_price,display_order=EXCLUDED.display_order,active=EXCLUDED.active,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=health_examination_batch_services.row_version+1 WHERE health_examination_batch_services.batch_id=EXCLUDED.batch_id AND health_examination_batch_services.service_id=EXCLUDED.service_id AND health_examination_batch_services.row_version=EXCLUDED.row_version
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batch_services s WHERE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_participant_services p WHERE p.batch_service_id=s.id))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batch_days d WHERE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batch_participants p WHERE p.batch_day_id=d.id))
mapper.sql: organization_id=#{organizationId} AND (LOWER(batch_code) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE chr(92) OR LOWER(name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE chr(92))
mapper.select: SELECT id,batch_code,name AS batch_name,(SELECT MIN(examination_date) FROM public.health_examination_batch_days d WHERE d.batch_id=b.id) AS start_date,(SELECT MAX(examination_date) FROM public.health_examination_batch_days d WHERE d.batch_id=b.id) AS end_date,status,created_at,updated_at FROM public.health_examination_batches b WHERE ORDER BY batch_codenamestart_datestatuscreated_atid DESCASC,id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
